issues.detail: The Greek 'εξ αυτων' (from them/out of them) is translated as 'thuộc về bọn họ' (belongs to them). In the context of John 12:20, 'εξ αυτων' refers to being 'from among them' or 'one of them', indicating his origin/association with the group, rather than a matter of ownership/belonging.
